name: bullet-dodge
description: Bullet Dodge Game - iOS & Android Capacitor Web App

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html','game.js','style.css','auth.js','default_lobby_banner.png','goldie_voyager_skin.png','cyber_buddy_skin.png'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, path.join('www', f))); if(fs.existsSync('images')) fs.cpSync('images', 'www/images', {recursive: true});"

author: artgourmet
